model_output.verdict: An ICU nurse with clear patient care experience and a couple of roles that need more detail.
write_up: A recruiter can see your medical ICU and telemetry experience, your Arizona RN license, and your CCRN. Your current patient-care line works especially well: it names the patients you care for, how many you care for per shift, and the kind of unit.
The questions come with your charge nurse and sepsis committee work. A little more about what you do in each would round out an already clear nursing resume.

cards.line: - Provide direct care for 2 critically ill patients per shift in a 24-bed medical ICU
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as your model. It puts your responsibility and the setting together, so a recruiter doesn't have to guess.

cards.line: - Serve as charge nurse two shifts per month
cards.cannot_tell: The frequency is clear, but a recruiter can't tell what you handle as charge nurse. Name the responsibilities that come with those shifts.
cards.example: Serve as charge nurse two shifts per month, with responsibility for [charge nurse responsibilities]
cards.question: What are you responsible for during your charge nurse shifts?

cards.line: - Member of the unit's sepsis bundle compliance committee
cards.cannot_tell: Committee membership tells a recruiter where you participate, but not what you contribute. What work is yours?
cards.example: Member of the unit's sepsis bundle compliance committee, contributing [your contribution]
cards.question: What have you contributed to the sepsis bundle compliance committee?

fit.note: Your experience points most directly to medical ICU nursing, with earlier telemetry work. The patient loads and treatments make your bedside work easy to recognize.
